thread:
katie: @here starting the change window for canary rollout v2026-03-21. quick watch on SLO dashboards pls
deploy-bot: rolling deploy initiated: service=embed-service, version=v1.12.0-canary, batch=10% -> 30%
alex: copying release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v1.12.0 (minor perf/kv-cache tweak)
priya: watching p95 on eu-west embed route, have dashboards up
jamie: seeing a small bump in 5xx on embed-service (eu-west) — p95 -> 1.15s from 0.45s
maria: same, errors trending upward, 5xx spike at 02:12 UTC
ops-bot: Alert: embed-service (eu-west) 5xx-rate = 0.9% > threshold 0.5% for 3m
alex: can we confirm it's not just synthetic noise? any deploys to dependent services?
priya: checking downstream reranker, nothing unusual. Top traces show KV cache misses and slower blob fetches
jamie: logs snippet:
```
embed-service: request_id=abc123 error="timeout fetching model shard" duration=320ms
embed-service: request_id=def456 kv_cache_miss=true
```
katie: ops-bot, what's the impact on user-facing SLO (search-embed route)?
ops-bot: search-embed.p95 = 1.12s (baseline 0.44s), error-rate = 0.8% (baseline 0.12%)
alex: that's enough to consider pausing. Can we pin traffic back to v1.11.9 and hold?
priya: we can pin routing with the rollout API, ready to flip if we get consensus
maria: +1 to pause — this is affecting live calls beyond canary cohort
jamie: suggested immediate action: pause rollout, pin canary traffic to previous stable, open postmortem ticket if needed
katie: let's be surgical: pause and pin, capture logs for the canary pods, then revert canary image. Who will run the pin?
alex: I'll run the pin now
alex: `curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/rollouts/pin -d '{"service":"embed-service","to":"v1.11.9"}'`
deploy-bot: action=pin_traffic service=embed-service from=v1.12.0-canary to=v1.11.9 status=success
ops-bot: Notice: rollout paused, traffic pinned to v1.11.9. Canary instances scaled to 0
priya: confirming metrics — p95 back near baseline (0.48s) and 5xx down to 0.13%
maria: tagging eng-runtime and eng-releases for follow-up postmortem
jamie: I'm grabbing canary pod logs and core dumps for infra team. Will upload to the incident playbook
katie: add annot: "hold_reason: kv-cache miss / model shard timeout" to the rollout entry
alex: done — rollout metadata updated
priya: recommend we mark the release as blocked and revert release notes link from website until next attempt
jamie: can we run a quick binary diff? maybe the quantization flag changed in the build that touched KV keys
maria: scheduling a quick blameless review with runtime team at +15m; invite eng-runtime, eng-infra
katie: for now, no rollback to stable needed beyond pin. logging owners: @jamie (runtime), @priya (observability), @alex (release ops)
deploy-bot: Note: audit log appended: user=alex action=pin_traffic service=embed-service reason="canary 5xx spike" timestamp=6223344689
alex: thanks team. we'll re-run canary after root cause. logging the release-blocker in JIRA (#RED-8765)
priya: adding a small canary test harness to exercise shard fetch paths before next rollout
jamie: any other quick mitigations? maybe increase cache TTL while investigating
maria: careful — changing TTL may mask underlying issue. prefer targeting the fetch timeout or retry logic in code
katie: agreed. action items: 1) runtime to triage shard timeouts; 2) QA to run targeted canary tests; 3) release ops to coordinate next attempt and update release notes. I'll post a summary in #release-updates when we have RCA
alex: will update ticket and close this thread once follow-ups are scheduled
priya: thanks all :thumbsup:
